description: Build the dependency-free i18n foundation: a Lang='ja'|'en' type, two COMPLETE message dictionaries (ja + en), a tiny React context/provider + useI18n() hook (t(key) + lang + setLang) persisted to localStorage, English stage labels in shared, and lang-aware versions of the pure UI helpers. Keep all existing JA behavior byte-identical and keep every current test green; add new EN + dictionary-parity + formatter tests. No implementation of the toggle UI or component rewiring yet (that is FEAT-002) and no chat-AI language (FEAT-003) here, but the pure helpers this feature adds are what those features consume. This feature establishes and unit-tests the layer; the baseline (`npm run build`, shared 47 tests, frontend 33 tests) is already green, so start by confirming that, then build on it.
steps: Confirm baseline is green before changing anything: from repo root run `npm run build` (expect exit 0), `npm test` (expect 47 pass), and `cd packages/frontend && env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --experimental-strip-types --test src/game-ui.test.ts` (expect 33 pass).

In packages/shared/src/stages.ts: add a `labelEn: string` field to the StageConfig interface and populate it for every stage in STAGES (baby='Baby', rookie='Rookie', champion='Champion', ultimate='Ultimate'). Leave labelJa untouched. Add `nextLabelEn` and `currentLabelEn` to the EvolutionProgress interface and populate them in evolutionProgress() alongside the existing *Ja fields (currentLabelEn = current.labelEn; nextLabelEn = next?.labelEn ?? null; at the final stage currentLabelEn is set and nextLabelEn is null). Do NOT rename or remove the existing *Ja fields. Rebuild shared so backend/frontend see the new types (`npm run build -w @ddm/shared`).

Create packages/frontend/src/i18n.ts: a React/DOM-free-where-possible module exporting `export type Lang = 'ja' | 'en';`, a `MESSAGES` dictionary of shape `Record<Lang, Record<MessageKey, string>>` with TWO complete sets of keys covering EVERY current UI string (see acceptance criteria for the audited string inventory), a pure `t(lang, key)` lookup that returns MESSAGES[lang][key] and falls back to the JA value then to the key itself if a key is missing, and `LANG_STORAGE_KEY = 'ddm.lang'`. Keep the dictionary and t() pure and importable by the Node test runner (no top-level DOM/React at import time; put React context in a separate section or guard it). Default language is 'ja'. Keys should be stable string identifiers (e.g. 'app.title', 'care.feed', 'battle.start', 'chat.send', 'chat.disabledHint', 'stats.mood', 'evolution.next', etc.). Derive MessageKey from the ja dictionary's keys so TypeScript enforces that en has the same keys.

In packages/frontend/src/i18n.ts add the React layer: a `LangContext`, an `I18nProvider` component that holds lang state initialized from localStorage (LANG_STORAGE_KEY) defaulting to 'ja' when absent/invalid, exposes `{ lang, setLang, t }` where setLang persists to localStorage and updates state, and a `useI18n()` hook returning that value with t bound to the current lang. Reading localStorage must be guarded so it never throws (e.g. wrapped in try/catch) and defaults to 'ja'. Keep JA as the default so the existing demo does not regress.

In packages/frontend/src/ui-helpers.ts: generalize the JA-only helpers to be language-aware WITHOUT breaking existing JA signatures. Add English stage labels using the new shared labelEn (e.g. a lang-aware `stageLabel(stageId, lang)`), and lang-aware variants of winnerLabel, battleLogLine, battleLog, formatMinutes, and moodLabel. Preferred approach: keep the existing *Ja functions exported and byte-identical (so current tests pass unchanged) and add new lang-param functions (e.g. `stageLabel(stageId, lang)`, `winnerLabel(winner, lang)`, `battleLogLine(line, lang, names?)`, `battleLogList(log, lang)`, `formatMinutes(ms, lang)`, `moodLabel(monster, lang)`) that return JA strings byte-identical to the *Ja versions when lang='ja'. For English: winner headlines (e.g. 'Victory! 🎉' / 'Defeat… 💥' / 'Draw 🤝'); battle log lines in English (reuse TURN_LINE_RE/RESULT_LINE_RE; e.g. 'Turn 1: {attacker} attacks! {defender} takes {dmg} damage (enemy HP {hp})' and 'Result: {winner headline}'); formatMinutes EN as '{n} min'; moodLabel EN strings mapping the same priority order (sleeping/dirty/very hungry/getting hungry/happy). Add an EN variant of the baby canned reply: keep BABY_SPEECH_TEXT as the exact JA string and add BABY_SPEECH_TEXT_EN plus a `babySpeechText(lang)` helper that returns the right one (JA value must stay byte-identical to the backend canned reply). Keep everything pure and React-free.

In packages/frontend/src/game-ui.test.ts: do NOT remove or change the existing 33 assertions (they lock JA byte-for-byte). Add new tests: (a) stageLabel(_, 'en') returns Baby/Rookie/Champion/Ultimate and stageLabel(_, 'ja') matches stageLabelJa; (b) winnerLabel/battleLogLine/formatMinutes/moodLabel with lang='ja' equal their *Ja counterparts, and with lang='en' return the English strings; (c) babySpeechText('ja')===BABY_SPEECH_TEXT and babySpeechText('en')===BABY_SPEECH_TEXT_EN; (d) a dictionary parity test importing MESSAGES that asserts Object.keys(MESSAGES.ja) and Object.keys(MESSAGES.en) are identical SETS (sorted-equal), so no key can go missing; (e) a t() fallback test: a missing key falls back (to the ja value or the key) rather than returning undefined. Keep DOM/React out of this test file; only import pure exports from i18n.ts and ui-helpers.ts.
Rebuild and run both suites: `npm run build` (root), `npm test` (shared), and the frontend ui-helpers runner. Fix any type errors from the new shared fields.
acceptance_criteria: packages/shared/src/stages.ts StageConfig has labelEn for all four stages (Baby/Rookie/Champion/Ultimate) and EvolutionProgress exposes currentLabelEn/nextLabelEn alongside the untouched *Ja fields; `npm run build -w @ddm/shared` succeeds.

packages/frontend/src/i18n.ts exports Lang, MESSAGES (ja+en with identical key sets), a pure t(lang,key) with fallback, LANG_STORAGE_KEY='ddm.lang', and a React I18nProvider + useI18n() hook that persists to localStorage and defaults to 'ja'.

The dictionary covers every audited current UI string: App title 'デジタルモンスター育成', loading '読み込み中…', 'モンスターを準備できませんでした。', footer '進化条件: トレーニング回数 ＋ 経過時間 ／ セーブは自動です'; CarePanel 'お世話'/'餌やり'/'トレーニング'/'睡眠'/'起こす'/'清掃' + hint; StatsPanel 'きぶん: ', 'HP'(stays HP), '攻撃', '防御', 'トレーニング回数: ', '進化条件', '最終段階（{stage}）', '次の段階: ', 'トレーニング ', '経過 '; BattlePanel 'バトル', '⚔️ 野生のモンスターと戦う', 'VS'(stays), enemy-name template, winner headlines; ChatPanel '会話', disabled hint, placeholder 'メッセージを入力', '送信', '話しかけてみよう！', aria-label 'メッセージ'; EvolutionBanner '進化した！'/'になった！'/'閉じる'; aria-labels お世話/ステータス/バトル/会話. Each has a JA and an EN translation.

ui-helpers.ts exposes lang-aware stageLabel/winnerLabel/battleLogLine/battleLogList/formatMinutes/moodLabel plus babySpeechText and BABY_SPEECH_TEXT_EN; for lang='ja' every one returns output byte-identical to the pre-existing *Ja helper.
All existing frontend ui-helper tests (33) still pass unchanged, and new tests for EN output, lang='ja' equivalence, dictionary key-set parity, and t() fallback pass. Shared suite still 47+ pass.
`npm run build` from repo root exits 0.
verification: From repo root: `npm run build` exits 0.
From repo root: `npm test` reports shared pass count >= 47, 0 fail.
`cd packages/frontend && env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --experimental-strip-types --test src/game-ui.test.ts` reports > 33 tests, 0 fail, including the new EN/parity/fallback tests.
findings: Implemented the dependency-free i18n foundation. shared/src/stages.ts: added labelEn (Baby/Rookie/Champion/Ultimate) to StageConfig and currentLabelEn/nextLabelEn to EvolutionProgress + evolutionProgress() (final stage: currentLabelEn set, nextLabelEn null); all *Ja fields untouched. No shared test deep-equals the whole EvolutionProgress object, so adding fields was safe (47 shared tests still pass). Rebuilt @ddm/shared so frontend typechecks against the new dist. Created frontend/src/i18n.ts: Lang type, DEFAULT_LANG='ja', LANG_STORAGE_KEY='ddm.lang', JA/EN MESSAGES with MessageKey derived from the JA dict so EN is compile-time key-parity enforced, pure t(lang,key) with fallback (lang dict -> JA value -> key itself), plus readStoredLang/isLang helpers and a React layer (LangContext, I18nProvider, useI18n). IMPORTANT: the React layer uses createElement (NOT JSX) so the module stays importable by node:test, which strips types but does not transform JSX; localStorage is only read lazily inside the provider via a guarded try/catch, never at module top level. ui-helpers.ts: added STAGE_LABELS_EN and lang-aware stageLabel/winnerLabel/battleLogLine/battleLogList/formatMinutes/moodLabel (each returns byte-identical JA output when lang='ja' by delegating to the existing *Ja fn) plus BABY_SPEECH_TEXT_EN and babySpeechText(lang); all existing *Ja exports kept byte-identical. EN battle log reuses TURN_LINE_RE/RESULT_LINE_RE. Added 16 new tests to game-ui.test.ts (EN output, lang='ja' equivalence, dictionary key-set parity, t() fallback, non-empty values for every key, DEFAULT_LANG) without touching the 33 existing JA assertions. Verification: `npm run build` exit 0; shared `npm test` 47 pass / 0 fail; frontend runner 49 pass / 0 fail. No external deps added. Components are NOT yet rewired to use t()/lang-aware helpers (that is FEAT-002) and the toggle UI + chat-AI language (FEAT-003) are out of scope here. EN wording for footer/hints/baby reply chosen for clarity; FEAT-002/003 can refine copy if desired.
